summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating 12-hour AM/PM time formatting (e.g., 8:00 AM - 9:00 AM, 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM, 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM) across all data entry screens, reports, charts, history logs, and Desktop PWA, alongside the Daily Bi-Hourly Audit tab and Admin/Auditor role permissions.
